title: storytold/photocraft
why_read: A clean-room Rust reimplementation of Photoshop is an ambitious systems engineering project that will interest people curious about graphics programming, GPU rendering, or large-scale app architecture in Rust.
analysis: This project aims to reimplement core Adobe Photoshop functionality from scratch in Rust without referencing Adobe's source code, which is a substantial undertaking spanning image compositing, layers, filters, and UI. Its real technical interest lies in the engineering choices needed to make a performant, memory-safe image editor, and it's a good read for anyone interested in Rust graphics stacks or large open-source clones of proprietary software.
